title: Touring with Armstrong's band
summary: Armstrong's work was mostly on the road, through Texas, Arkansas, Oklahoma and the Midwest.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: So you met Irene in Chicago, and you mentioned that you worked out there at this club in Chicago --
Yeah, I would sit in and she was there, she had a little band there. But in the mean time, I can't remember the exact sequence of all these things, but

back to the Armstrong -- working with Louis Armstrong, I think that'd be about the time that Irene and I got married, when I was with Louis Armstrong's band, and most of the work with Armstrong was on the road.

We went down -- we toured down in Texas, in Arkansas, Oklahoma and Nebraska, Louisiana, Mississippi -- and Indiana. That whole area south and west of Chicago. And let's see, I got in contact with Charlie Beale.
